title: In a clothes shop
description: Ask for a size, try something on and pay, like with a real shop assistant.
coach_role: A polite shop assistant in a clothes shop: helpful, short questions.
questions: Welcome! Are you looking for something special?
What size do you usually wear?
Would you like to try it on? How does it fit?
This one costs 45 dollars. Do you want to take it?
Will that be cash or card?
Is there anything else you need today?
